title: PSHS-CARC OPCR — stable form definition
description: Columns 1-5 of the OPCR: the DOST Strategic Plan Alignment, the PSHSS Program, and the Performance Indicators. These do not change between fiscal years, so they are fixed here rather than re-entered each cycle. A year's OPCR supplies only the per-year fields listed under 'per_year_fields', keyed by indicator id.

strategic_plan_reference.issuance: DOST Administrative Order No. 017, Series of 2023
strategic_plan_reference.note: pillar, pillar_number, outcome, outcome_number, strategy and sub_strategy are DERIVED from strategy_number and sub_strategy_index. Do not edit them independently; the plan assigns each strategy to exactly one pillar and outcome. pillar_number is null for strategies 17-20, which belong to Cross-cutting Strategies — there is no DOST Pillar 5.

form.agency_organizational_outcome: Increased Competitiveness of Filipinos in Science and Engineering
form.dimension_legend_note: Printed on the form as '1 - Quantity 2 - Efficiency 3 - Timeliness 4 - Average'. CSC SPMS forms more commonly read 'Quality' for dimension 1; this form reads Quantity and that wording is authoritative here.

columns.label: Means of Verification
columns.note: Not printed on the FY2025 form; included here as a defined column.

form.column_header_note: The printed form wraps 'Division/Individual Accountable' and 'Actual Accomplishment' onto two lines with a rule between them; that rule is a layout artifact, not a sub-header split.

indicator_fields.id: Program letter and sequence within the program, e.g. 'D.1'. The join key used by the MOV schema and by a year's data.
indicator_fields.dimensions: Which of quantity/efficiency/timeliness the indicator is measured on. A year's target, actual_accomplishment and rating must fill exactly these and leave the others null (Not Applicable).
indicator_fields.measure_type: Unit of the figures: percentage, count, rank, percentile.
indicator_fields.comparator: Direction of the target: at_least, within_top, exactly. Needed once ratings are computed from actual against target.

per_year_fields: target (per dimension, plus explanation and raw)
actual_accomplishment (per dimension, plus explanation and raw)
commitment and sign-off signatories and dates
